Recently my experience at happy tails was really bad.
My dogs regular doctor wasn't there and some other doctors attended to him, but this doctor was new I think and not that experienced also.but the worst part was that even when they knew after all the tests they did that my dog had fever and needed the saline etc...while that was being done...they were just rushing with everything because it was their closing time.

We can blindly recommend Happy Tails to anyone!

featured_reviews.name: sms sweta
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a pet parent, I’m sure many of you will understand the kind of fear and helplessness we feel when something isn’t right with our baby. I went through exactly that when my 14-year-old feline, Goldie, was diagnosed with a serious tumour on her left paw. Those days were filled with worry, questions, and uncertainty.

All we knew was that we needed the right oncologist — someone we could trust completely. That’s when we found the incredible team at Superpets, and from that very first visit, everything began to feel a little lighter.

From explaining the diagnosis and possible causes, to guiding us through every test, every step was handled with so much patience, clarity, and compassion. What truly stood out was how reassuring the entire team was — always available to answer questions, clear doubts, and take that extra effort to make both us and Goldie feel comfortable.

The journey — from diagnosis, to surgery, to post-operative care and stitch removal — was smoother than we could have ever hoped for. Every decision they made felt right, thoughtful, and in Goldie’s best interest.

A special note of gratitude to Dr. Pratyush, Dr. Vasudha, and Dr. Gauri — you are truly angels in disguise. The care, dedication, and gentleness with which you handled Goldie means the world to us. It’s not just medical expertise, but your genuine love for animals that makes all the difference.

I must admit, I was initially skeptical about traveling all the way from the suburbs to Bandra for treatment — but today, I can say with complete conviction that every visit, every effort, was absolutely worth it.

What touched me deeply was that even after a month, Dr. Pratyush personally followed up to check on Goldie’s health. That level of care is rare and speaks volumes about the kind of people they are — not just doctors, but true lifesavers.

This entire experience has been a journey of gratitude. People like them are not just treating animals — they are healing families.

Thank you, Superpets team, from the bottom of my heart, for taking such beautiful care of our baby.

Forever grateful. 🙏🏻

featured_reviews.name: Harsh Chhangani
featured_reviews.review_text: A very professional and qualified set of Doctors who streamline diagnosis and start the correct treatment extremely fast without wasting any time. Thankful to Dr. Omkar for his professionalism and patience with all my questions. He started the diagnosis & treatment for my 48 day old Lab puppy when we rushed him in at 12am. Follow-ups were extremely smooth thanks to Dr. Shefali as she was extremely kind and generous with my pet. She knew exactly what needed to be done and the internal communication between the doctors are spot on and on the same page. I really loved the fact that each doctor is on the same page even the one who is not treating my puppy, Dr. Nishant. The set of Doctors help and consult each other well to discuss exactly which treatment will be right for the pet. I used to believe SuperPets is an expensive clinic which will keep doing tests to increase bill but when I visited the clinic I realised, I was so wrong. Everything right from follow-ups, to chat support, to the doctors actually calling/messaging you to check how your pet is doing post the treatment are all just professional and seamless. I would recommend SuperPets 10/10 after my experience.

featured_reviews.name: Mira Saraf
featured_reviews.review_text: I've been taking my dogs, Angel and Cookie, as well as our new kitten Oreo to Dr. Gauri and Dr. Pratyush (and more recently Dr. Nikhil) at Superpets for the last several years, and they've all been really well-looked after. They never push me towards any unnecessary treatments, but when there is an issue, they handle it quickly and effectively, explaining all the options. featured_reviews.review_text: This is the best vet experience I've had till now. All the staff, including the service staff are very courteous, kind and helpful. featured_reviews.name: Smitaa Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a blessing. My German shepherd champ was taken to super pets in an emergency situation. He had developed something called GDV. I was unaware if this situation being a pet parent since more than 17 years now (I have had pets since several years) After taking him to vetic hospital for emergency (which was extremely careless and didn’t even treat it like emergency) post his X-ray on recommendation from some friends I rushed him to super pets. They immediately took charge of the situation. He underwent operation and was discharged in 5 days. We had to take him for regular follow ups and on a follow up in a weeks time, doctors suspected something wrong and again on further tests discovered that his spleen had got affected and damaged along with few further conditions that had developed. He underwent second surgery. He battled for his life for a month in this hospital. He was hospitalised. The care, affection and love he recieved along with the proper medical care is nothing less than a gift for parents seeing their child fight for life and death each day. Inspite of he being aggressive he was pampered and taken care of as if he belongs to them. His entire body had collapsed and post 1 month he finally got discharged. He had lost his ability to walk post all this condition as his hip and spine had got affected. We continued Physio with them. It’s October today. My boy got discharged in June and we are in our way for our regular Physio all hail and hearty, not just walking but running and bullying my other 2 dogs :) No words can thank them enough. His recovery is nothing less than a miracle only because of timely care and attention given to him by the super vets at super pets.

Animals have rights too—and it is our responsibility to know and uphold them.
Animal welfare laws are designed to protect animals from cruelty, neglect, and abuse, ensuring they live with dignity and care. When we are informed about these laws, we become stronger voices for those who cannot speak for themselves.

Know a few important animal welfare rules in India:
• Causing cruelty, injury, or abandonment of animals is a punishable offence under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960.
• Feeding or caring for community animals is legal and protected.
• Injured or sick animals must be given timely medical care.
• Animals have the right to food, water, shelter, and freedom from pain and fear.

I rescued a severely injured stray cat who was left to die on the road. One of his legs was badly damaged, and with genuine intention to save his life, I brought him here hoping he would receive proper treatment.

Instead of focusing on immediate care or suggesting alternate support options, I was asked to pay ₹5,000–₹6,000 upfront, while being told the total treatment could cost around ₹22,000. As someone who tried to help purely on humanitarian grounds, this was extremely discouraging.

I clearly explained my financial situation and honestly said that I could manage only ₹600–₹700 from my side, which was my genuine capacity. Unfortunately, there was no flexibility, no discussion about raising donations through their network, social media, or other sponsors — which I believe NGOs usually do.

With a heavy heart, I had no option but to leave the cat there, feeling helpless and guilty, knowing he might continue to suffer.

This experience was emotionally distressing and disappointing.

"PLEASE READ BEFORE ENTRUSTING YOUR PET HERE"

I am sharing my experience so that other pet parents can make informed decisions and hopefully avoid the pain and trauma I have gone through.

My dog, Lambhorgini, was admitted to this veterinary hospital on 17 December 2025 at approximately 11:00 PM. The veterinarian on duty insisted that he be admitted for “better treatment” and informed us that pet parents were not allowed to stay back in the hospital. Trusting the professional advice given, we agreed to the admission.

At the time of admission, he was placed on oxygen and, while I was present, appeared to be stabilizing and recovering. At no point was I informed that his condition was critical or that his life was at immediate risk.

The following morning, I was informed that he had passed away at an estimated time of 8:30 AM.

What has been most distressing is not only the sudden loss of my deeply loved pet, but the lack of communication, transparency, and responsibility throughout the process. Even post-event, no clear explanation or accountability was provided by the designated veterinarian on duty at the time.

As a pet parent from Singapore, I am extremely disappointed by the quality, efficiency, and professionalism experienced at this facility. Entrusting a beloved companion to a hospital should come with honest updates, proper communication, and accountability — all of which were lacking in this experience.

Based on what I went through, I would strongly advise other pet parents not to entrust their pets to this facility at any given time. Pets deserve competent care and responsible medical oversight, especially during critical situations.

I am sharing this review solely so that other pet parents can make an informed choice and do not experience the same heartbreak.

Sakeena Thakker , pet parent of Lambhorgini

The house feels emptier tonight. No familiar footsteps, no silent stare, no demanding presence that ruled the home for years. But she is no longer in pain now. She is in safe hands, somewhere peaceful beyond our understanding.

A special thank you to the stupendous and animal loving staff and doctors and specially Dr Krishna for standing by us and helping us through these difficult last months of Dusty’s sickness, care, and treatment. Your kindness, support, and compassion will never be forgotten.

Rest in peace, Dusty.
You were family.
You were loved deeply.
And you will be missed every single day for a long time.

featured_reviews.review_text:

Dear Pratha Gudhka, 
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us. We sincerely regret that your experience did not meet your expectations.

Following your review, we had a detailed discussion with Dr. Barry regarding your consultation. He mentioned that approximately 20 minutes were spent examining your pet and discussing the orthopedic condition along with the possible surgical options, including FHO (Femoral Head Ostectomy) and Total Hip Replacement. During the consultation, you had also mentioned that you would consider the FHO procedure over hip replacement at this stage. Additionally, the importance of weight management as part of the long-term orthopedic care plan was also discussed.

Dr. Barry often encourages clients to conduct their own research and note down additional questions regarding orthopedic procedures, as these surgeries are complex and require careful planning, discussion, and understanding before proceeding further. His intention was to help you make a well-informed decision regarding your pet’s treatment options.

That being said, we truly apologize if the consultation came across as incomplete or unsatisfactory from your perspective. We understand and respect the time, effort, and travel involved in visiting us, and we appreciate your honest feedback as it helps us improve our communication and overall client experience.

Thank you once again for bringing this to our attention. We will continue working hard to ensure better experiences for all our clients in the future.
Regards,
Top Dog Team.
